title: DarkCry 1.0 — Canon Registry
status: editorial reference; keep synchronized with Dropbox CTs and the Atlas
principles: The four Pilares remain the four trunk works; satellite, transversal and route projects do not create a fifth Pilar.
Discographic order, classification position and diegetic event order are different fields.
A voice/avatar does not automatically identify a separate protagonist.
A transmutation or repeated track does not automatically represent a new diegetic event.
A/B is assigned only to a deliberately designed counterpart or branch; never infer it from vocalist alone.

pillars.title: The Invisible Boy
pillars.function: childhood domestic wound and Cold Law

pillars.title: Crying in the Bubblebath
pillars.function: failed search, somatic transaction and impossible cleansing

pillars.title: Walking through the Blue Street
pillars.function: urban alienation, grief and emotional numbing

pillars.title: I'm bad, so Bad
pillars.function: Dolly's neon armor and reactive counterattack

transversalCoordinates.X: childhood and early domestic reality; parallel to Era 1.0
transversalCoordinates.Y: adolescence, grooming/exploitation, urban flight and defensive hardening; crosses 1.5–3.0
transversalCoordinates.Z: adulthood; affective/domestic and material/economic dimensions; after Era 4.0

classification.trackingMarkers: TM1–TM3 belong to The Horror Film That Is My Life; do not conflate them with X/Y/Z.

eraZ.relationshipContext: approximately four years of marriage with Cristopher

dimensions.affective: domesticity, marriage, intimacy, desire, self-sabotage and Violet/Dolly defensive responses
dimensions.material: work, corporations, dismissal, debt and economic pressure

routeA.name: Incineration
routeA.outcome: provisional defensive victory through counterattack, control and escape

routeB.name: Negotiation leading toward asphyxia
tracks: A Bitter Swallow / the best part is the end
routeB.outcome: provisional defensive victory through staying, self-silencing and somatic withdrawal

eraZ.routeRule: A/B labels describe narrative counterpart/route affiliation, not voice identity. A song may belong to Route B while containing Dolly's interventions.

projects: My LIVE HOME — Side B / A Plea for Shelter
convergentLines.placement: A Plea for Shelter Side B is placed after When the Sky Turned Crimson (and warm), Era 1.9.
convergentLines.diegeticRelation: Its material journey (street, hunger, shelter, hotels and survival) runs through the same urban traversal represented emotionally by Walking through the Blue Street.
convergentLines.interpretation: Convergent perspectives of one journey, not two wholly consecutive journeys.

convergentLines.relation: Era 3.9 echo/re-reading of experiences from the convergent urban traversal.
convergentLines.rule: Repeated or transmuted tracks must not be counted as new nights or events unless a source explicitly establishes a new event.

toñoConnections.function: attempt to erase the relationship and move through the city Toño had spoken about
searching for the feeling associated with Toño in other bodies and encounters
explicit abandonment and waiting; the loss continues during material survival

transmutation.moneda: two faces of a shared conceptual seed; wording, perspective, rhythm or structure may vary
transmutation.espejo: a deliberately paired reflection/inversion; may preserve verbal material while changing arrangement or affective temperature
transmutation.darkVersion: corruption or hardening of an earlier seed into a defensive function
transmutation.temporalRule: classify the relationship first; do not infer a new event solely from a new title, arrangement or version

voices.Violet: repliegue, self-blame, accommodation and withdrawal; remains possible after Era 4.0 and reappears in Z-B
voices.Dolly: counterattack, control, provocation and escape; dominant in Era 4.0 and reappears in Z-A
voices.DCX: distinct Kitsune-mask/anonymous persona; not an interchangeable synonym for Dolly

symbolicChains.meaning: refuge, intimacy, transaction and eventual confinement
material hunger becomes affective appetite and domestic disconnection
comfort, coercion, repetition and the reversal of the trapped/guardian image
romantic shelter, attempted reconnection and somatic mourning

Smoke in the Kitchen.note: Do not describe as released before the confirmed publication date.

coverInventory.rule: These figures refer to different inventories and must not be presented as one shared total until the catalogue is reconciled.
